label: configurator • change the global hotkey via the app section
query: Change my global Osaurus hotkey to Command-Shift-O.
notes: `app.hotkey` in text form (`cmd+shift+o`; glyph form `⌘⇧O` also parses). The 'shift' matcher probes the document text. The runner restores ChatConfiguration (which stores the hotkey) after the case.
